description: The text below is about the account payable process that begins when you email to the vendor's accounting department. Once the sending to the vendor accounting department occurs, creating a receiving report should be made. Once creation of a receiving report occurs, one or more of the following path should be executed: confirming all documents have been amended, reporting error to the relevant team member. After confirming all documents have been amended, the double check should do a three-way match. Afterwards, checking of dates to avoid penalty fees must be done. The process is now complete.

fields.completion_step: checking of dates to avoid penalty fees must be done
